role: set of finite IPL formulas over the specified atom set
notes: Primitive bottom, conjunction, disjunction and implication; negation abbreviates implication to bottom.

role: finite-support propositional LJ derivability from a formula set
notes: A finite multiset over Gamma witnesses the relation; arbitrary premise sets remain permitted.

role: single-succedent LJ sequent with finite-multiset antecedent
notes: Exactly one formula in the succedent; exchange is implicit in multisets.

role: worlds of the specified intuitionistic Kripke model
notes: Declared worlds; the finite-word convention belongs to a disjoint P4 scope.

role: reflexive transitive persistence order on worlds
notes: Original theorem uses partial orders; the explicitly compared variant permits preorders.

role: intuitionistic Kripke forcing of a formula at a world
notes: Defined implication quantifies over all future worlds; no world forces bottom.

role: forcing every member of a formula set at the same world
notes: Pointwise extension to arbitrary premise sets.

role: local consequence over all persistent partially ordered Kripke models
notes: Preorder and rooted-frame variants are named separately and proved equivalent.

role: deductive closure on subsets of the IPL formula universe
notes: Extensive, monotone and idempotent by finite-support substitution of LJ derivations.

role: formula set tested for avoidance of the target C
notes: A set avoids C when it does not derive C; maximality ranges over all extensions inside the fixed formula universe.

role: nth formula in a supplied enumeration
notes: The enumeration is assumed as data; no effective derivability test is claimed.

role: nth target-avoiding formula set in the enumerated construction
notes: Each successor is uniquely specified by a classical derivability case distinction.

role: poset of target-avoiding extensions, an inclusion chain, and its union
notes: Proof-local Zorn construction; the empty chain has Gamma as upper bound.

role: world set, atom valuation and canonical model above a prime root theory
notes: Contains all prime extensions of the root; later worlds need not omit the root's target formula.

role: finite subformula-closed set used for filtration
notes: A finite set of formulas, not a multiset sequent antecedent.

role: the set of formulas from Sigma forced at w
notes: Truth profile is a subset of Sigma; tau is not a sentence metavariable in this scope.

role: equality of finite subformula truth profiles
notes: Equivalence relation used to define the filtration quotient.

role: equivalence class of a world under equal Sigma truth profiles
notes: This denotes a set of worlds; it is not a proposition or formula equivalence class.

role: partial order on filtered worlds defined by inclusion of truth profiles
notes: Comparison includes implication formulas in Sigma and may add pairs absent from the original frame.

role: filtered world set, persistent atom valuation and finite model
notes: Atoms outside Sigma have the empty valuation; the model is defined for the entire language.

role: number of input subformulas and finite set of input atoms
notes: Local finite model search parameters; m is a natural number and P0 a set of atoms.

role: root and strict successor in the two-world countermodel
notes: Local worlds, not terms or assignments; reflexive loops are included.

role: propositional atom in the implication-composition example
notes: Explicit local atom role overrides the global term-metavariable default.
